alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.25% (+53bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-07-01
Current:  2.25%
90d low:  1.72%
Move:     +53bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year real (TIPS) yield jumped to 2.25% on 2026-07-01, up 0.53pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.72%.

内容:
10 年期实际（TIPS）收益率在 2026-07-01 跳升至 2.25%，较过去 90 天低点 1.72% 上升了 0.53 个百分点。

Why it matters:
Real yields spiking this fast tightens financial conditions and raises the discount rate on long-duration AI capex bets — the exact pressure that squeezes hyperscaler valuations and neocloud debt service. Crossing 2x the trigger on C10's ladder escalates this to HIGH.

影响:
实际收益率如此快速跳升会收紧金融条件，抬高长久期 AI capex 投资的贴现率——这正是压缩超大规模厂商估值和新云厂商债务偿付能力的那种压力。触及 C10 阶梯 2 倍触发阈值，信号升级为 HIGH。
